title: (NEW) Apple 96W USB-C Power Adapter
writeup: Apple's official 96W USB-C Power Adapter, brand new, is $23.97 at Woot while Apple and Walmart both charge $79 and B&H and Micro Center ask $79.99. It's the same 96W USB-C brick Apple sells today as MW2L3AM/A, enough to fast-charge a 14-inch MacBook Pro. The cable is sold separately, and Woot showed only one left at posting.
